violations.description: Secrets echoed and printed in CI logs
violations.evidence: echo "GitHub Token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" and echo "NPM_TOKEN=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" printed in CI log
violations.recommendation: Remove debugging steps that echo secrets or print token environment variables.

violations.description: Sensitive credential files uploaded as artifacts
violations.recommendation: Remove sensitive files from artifact upload paths.

violations.description: Hardcoded AWS secret access key in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded passwords and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded PyPI API token in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded tokens and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded tokens and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Tokens echoed and printed in release workflow logs
violations.evidence: echo "Publishing with token: $PYPI_API_TOKEN" and echo "Docker token is: $DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN"
violations.recommendation: Remove steps that print tokens to logs.

violations.description: Private SSH and environment keys uploaded as workflow artifacts
violations.recommendation: Remove private keys and local environment files from artifact upload paths.

violations.description: Bash debug mode set -x enabled in workflow handling secrets
violations.evidence: set -x enabled prior to using AWS environment variables
violations.recommendation: Remove set -x from steps where sensitive environment variables are used.

violations.description: Verbose curl command leaking authorization header secret
violations.recommendation: Remove -v or --verbose from curl commands that include authorization headers.

violations.description: Bash debug mode set -ex enabled in workflow handling tokens
violations.evidence: set -ex enabled in build step before token usage

violations.description: Verbose curl command leaking GitHub token authorization header
violations.recommendation: Remove --verbose from curl commands using authentication tokens.
